relevant_laws.notes: Outside both crosswalk categories, all roadway vehicles and 11.30.070 place status require original review.
relevant_laws.quote: Every pedestrian crossing a roadway at any point other than within a marked crosswalk or within an unmarked crosswalk at an intersection shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles upon the roadway. The foregoing rules in this Section shall have no application under the conditions stated in Section 11.30.070 when pedestrians are prohibited from crossing at certain designated places.
